rules: Never letter-space Arabic — it breaks the joins between letters.
Taller line-height (1.85 for body) to make room for dots and diacritics.
Latin digits (0–9) for prices and order numbers, as Saudi users expect.
Codes, numbers and phone numbers always render left-to-right.

faq: No one can guarantee an embassy’s decision. What we guarantee is a complete, well-prepared file that improves your chances — and full transparency at every step.
When do I pay the embassy fee?
With your application, shown as its own line on the invoice. We pass it to the authority as-is, with no markup.
Passport numbers and documents are encrypted, and we comply with Saudi Arabia’s Personal Data Protection Law. You can request deletion at any time.

items.a: No one can guarantee an embassy's decision. What we guarantee is a complete, carefully reviewed file that improves your chances — and transparency at every step.

items.q: Why is the embassy fee shown separately?
items.a: It goes to the government as-is with zero markup. We split it so you know exactly what you pay us for the service.

items.q: What if my application is refused?
items.a: Embassy fees are non-refundable under embassy rules. If a refusal was caused by our mistake, we refund the service fee in full or re-apply for free.

items.q: Can I apply for my family in one go?
items.a: Yes — add every traveller to one application and track them together, with a clear price per person.

items.q: How do I track my application?
items.a: From your dashboard or with your order number, plus a WhatsApp message at every update.

about.metaDesc: myvisa: a Saudi visa service built on transparency, speed and trust.
about.title: We built the service
about.lead: myvisa started from a familiar experience: unclear fees, missed appointments, unanswered questions. We set out to build the exact opposite.
story: Every Saudi traveller knows the anxiety before a trip: are the documents complete? When is the appointment? How much did I actually pay the embassy?
At myvisa we made the answers clear from the start. We show the full price, split, before you pay; we review your file carefully; and we tell you about every update the moment it happens.
